steps.description: Both hands loosen the rear screw and slide the black side panel off the chassis.
steps.done_when: the side panel is removed and the motherboard interior is fully exposed
steps.title: Open the computer case

steps.description: The hands take a small coin cell from the parts tray and press it into its motherboard holder.
steps.done_when: the battery is seated in its holder to retain BIOS settings
steps.title: Insert the coin-cell battery

steps.description: The hands pick up two memory modules and press them into the blue motherboard slots.
steps.done_when: both sticks are seated and their retaining clips are closed
steps.title: Install the RAM sticks

steps.description: The hands plug the red data lead and the power lead into the drive in the front bay.
steps.done_when: the drive is cabled for data and power and ready for use
steps.title: Connect the hard disk drive

steps.description: The hands route the small white fan connector to its motherboard header and push it on.
steps.done_when: the fan lead is connected so the fan can be powered and controlled
steps.title: Attach the cooling-fan cable

steps.description: The hands join PSU leads and plug the system power connectors onto the motherboard.
steps.done_when: the motherboard power feeds are firmly mated and dressed in place
steps.title: Attach the system power

steps.description: The hands wipe the inside of the chassis with a blue cloth.
steps.done_when: the interior is free of dust and ready for closing
steps.title: Clean the PC interior

steps.description: The hands lift the side panel from the chair, slide it onto the chassis and retighten the rear screw.
steps.done_when: the panel is flush, secured and the case is closed
steps.title: Close the computer case

steps.description: The hands connect mains and monitor leads, plug in and power on the unit to show boot on screen.
steps.done_when: the system powers on and the boot display confirms successful repair
steps.title: Test the repaired PC

task_summary: Repair a PC by opening the case, installing battery and RAM, cabling disk, fan and power, cleaning, closing and boot-testing.
